sql:
SELECT v.vendor_id, v.vendor_name, SUM(pl.qty * pl.unit_price_orig) AS usd_value_sep
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor v ON pl.vendor_id = v.vendor_id
WHERE pl.currency = 'USD' AND pl.period = '2026-09'
GROUP BY v.vendor_id, v.vendor_name
ORDER BY usd_value_sep DESC
LIMIT 5
